roadmap.name: Phase 1: Core Foundations — Algorithms, Languages, Books & SQL
roadmap.description: Master algorithmic patterns, C/C++ memory models, Java internals, and staff-level FAANG SQL.

weeks.title: Data Structures, Algorithms, CSES & C Programming
focus: Arrays, Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Hashing
C Programming: Pointers, Arena Allocators, Fixed-Width Types, Storage Classes & Linking
Greedy Algorithms, Trie Autocomplete, Recursion & State-Space Backtracking
CSES Problem Set: Introductory, Sorting & Searching tracks
weeks.deliverable: Solve 20 classic medium/hard problem patterns and track CSES progress.

weeks.title: Advanced Graph Algorithms, Dynamic Programming & CSES Mastery
focus: BFS, DFS, Kahn's Topological Sort, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, Union-Find / DSU
1D & 2D Dynamic Programming (Knapsack, LCS, LIS, Interval DP)
Line Sweep Geometry & Interval Overlap Mechanics
CSES: Range Queries, Tree Algorithms, and Graph Algorithmic Tracks
weeks.deliverable: Complete graph traversal & DP state formulation exercises across DSA and CSES problem sets.

weeks.title: Java Internals, Effective Java (90 Items), JCiP & FAANG SQL
focus: Effective Java 3rd Edition: All 12 Chapters and 90 Items thoroughly internalized
Java Concurrency in Practice: Monitors, Volatile, JMM Happens-Before, AQS & CLH Queues
Modern Java 21+: Project Loom Virtual Threads, Carrier Threads, StructuredTaskScope
FAANG Staff SQL: Window Functions, Gaps & Islands, User Sessionization, Cohort Retention
weeks.deliverable: Review all 90 Effective Java items, master AQS & JMM mechanics, and solve 6 FAANG Staff SQL interview patterns.

weeks.title: Advanced C++, STL & Modern Concurrency
focus: The C++ Programming Language & Tour of C++: RAII, Move Semantics, Templates
Effective Modern C++: Smart Pointers, Universal References, Perfect Forwarding, Lambdas
C++ Concurrency in Action: std::thread, Lock-Free Atomics, Memory Orders (Acquire/Release)
Java vs C++ Mind Map: Side-by-side systems comparison (GC vs RAII, Generics vs Templates)
weeks.deliverable: Master C++ memory management, implement lock-free concurrency patterns, and contrast with JVM runtime.

roadmap.name: Phase 2: System Design — Low-Level (LLD) & High-Level (HLD)
roadmap.description: Object-oriented modeling, GoF patterns, 5 full LLD systems, and 28 Alex Xu HLD architectures.

weeks.title: Object-Oriented Analysis, Design Principles & SOLID
focus: SOLID Principles (Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov, ISP, Dependency Inversion)
Encapsulation, Polymorphism, and Composition vs Inheritance trade-offs
Class Diagrams, Sequence Diagrams, and UML Domain Modeling
weeks.deliverable: Diagram and code domain models for complex real-world entities.

weeks.title: Gang of Four (GoF) Design Patterns in Practice
focus: Creational: Singleton, Factory Method, Abstract Factory, Builder, Prototype
Structural: Adapter, Composite, Proxy, Decorator, Facade, Bridge, Flyweight
Behavioral: Strategy, Observer, Command, State, Chain of Resp, Mediator, Template
weeks.deliverable: Implement GoF design patterns in clean, production-grade Java without boilerplate.

weeks.title: Low-Level System Design (LLD) Production Systems
focus: Elevator System Design, LRU Cache, Parking Lot, Vending Machine, ATM System
Concurrency safety, thread-safe collections, lock granularities, and state transitions
9 1-Page PDF Quick Revision Cards for LLD interviews
weeks.deliverable: End-to-end implementation and test coverage of 5 full LLD interview systems.

weeks.title: High-Level System Design (HLD), Alex Xu, Architecture & Microservices
focus: The 4-Step HLD Interview Framework: Scope, Availability Math, Capacity Math, 80/20 RAM sizing
Alex Xu Vol 1 & 2: Rate Limiter, Snowflake ID, TinyURL, Crawler, Chat, YouTube, Proximity, Disruptor
Fundamentals of Software Architecture: Instability (I), Distance from Main Sequence (D), ADRs
Monolith to Microservices (Sam Newman): Strangler Fig, Branch by Abstraction, CDC, Saga
weeks.deliverable: Master back-of-the-envelope calculations, architect 28 systems, and implement ArchUnit fitness functions.

roadmap.name: Phase 3: Systems, Networking, Database Engineering & Distributed Systems
roadmap.description: Kernel syscalls, epoll, TCP/IP, B+ trees, LSM-trees, WAL, Raft consensus, and parallel computing.

weeks.title: Operating Systems (OSTEP), UIUC CS341 & Computer Networks
focus: OSTEP Virtualization: fork/exec, PCB, MLFQ 5 rules, Multi-Level Page Tables, TLB, Clock Page Faults
OSTEP Concurrency & Persistence: Futex locks, Condition Variables, VSFS, Inodes, WAL Journaling
Computer Networks: HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3 QUIC, TCP 3-Way Handshake & BBR, CIDR, BGP, ARP
UIUC CS341 System Programming: POSIX sockets, epoll event loops, memory allocation
weeks.deliverable: Master kernel syscalls, LDE protocol, Linux epoll, TCP state machine, and BGP routing mechanics.

weeks.title: Database System Concepts, Database Internals, DDIA & Distributed Systems
focus: Database System Concepts: Relational Algebra, BCNF Normalization, Volcano Iterator, ARIES Recovery
Database Internals (Alex Petrov): B-Link Trees, LSM SSTable compaction, Raft Consensus, 2PC/3PC
Designing Data-Intensive Applications (DDIA): Storage engines, encoding, replication, partitioning, batch/stream
Top-Tier University Papers: MIT 6.5840 (MapReduce, Raft), Stanford CS244B (DHT, BFT), CMU 15-418, Lucene
weeks.deliverable: Deep dive into ARIES 3-phase recovery, LSM compactions, Raft safety invariants, and Lucene inverted indexes.

roadmap.name: Phase 4: Infrastructure Tech-Stack, Security & High-Throughput Pipelines
roadmap.description: 16 tech-stack production guides, OAuth2/OIDC zero-trust security, and stream processing architectures.

weeks.title: Data Tier: Redis, Postgres, JDBC & Storage
focus: Redis: Data structures, event loop, persistence (RDB/AOF), sentinel, cluster, memory eviction
Relational Databases & Postgres: MVCC, VACUUM, indexes (B-Tree, GIN, GiST), connection pooling (HikariCP)
JDBC Internals: Batch updates, transactions, fetch size, statement caching
Object Storage & Cassandra: S3 consistency models, Cassandra distributed partitioning and LSM storage
weeks.deliverable: Benchmark HikariCP pooling, design Cassandra partition keys, and configure Redis caching strategies.

weeks.title: Streaming, Edge & Containers
focus: Apache Kafka: Broker architecture, partitions, consumer groups, rebalancing, zero-copy, idempotence
Gateways, Proxies & Load Balancers: NGINX, HAProxy, Envoy, Envoy service mesh, L4 vs L7 routing
Docker & Containers: Namespaces (cgroups, pid, net), union filesystems (Overlay2), multistage builds
Kubernetes: Control plane (etcd, scheduler, kube-apiserver), Pod lifecycle, Services, Ingress, Deployments
weeks.deliverable: Architect an end-to-end event pipeline with Kafka, tune Envoy routing rules, and write production K8s manifests.

weeks.title: API Security, Observability & High-Throughput Pipelines
focus: API Security in Action: OAuth2 authorization framework, OIDC identity, JWT verification, mTLS, Zero Trust
Observability Stack: Grafana dashboards, Prometheus metrics TSDB, Splunk log aggregation, OpenTelemetry
High-Throughput Data Pipelines: Ingestion layers, Parquet/ORC columnar formats, Snappy/Zstandard, Exactly-Once
Spring Boot & Hibernate: Application context lifecycle, Hibernate 1st/2nd level cache, N+1 query problem
weeks.deliverable: Implement OAuth2 mTLS authorization server, build Grafana monitoring dashboard, and optimize pipeline throughput.
